versions.summary: Initial publication. Government-limit standard (Method v2.0): each analyte is the strictest sovereign maximum for predatory fish by lookup, as-consumed basis. Mercury is limited in both forms (tHg 1000, MeHg 1000, the higher species-specific tier). Cadmium bound to 50 (Costa Rica general-fish ML, which does not except tuna/shark/marlin) after adversarial audit corrected an initial 100.
